headline: AI Chip Stocks Sink on OpenAI Revenue Report
detail: Reports on OpenAI's revenue are causing "undue concern" and a broad sell-off in AI-related chip stocks like Micron and Nvidia. This directly impacts your heavily concentrated tech/chip portfolio, especially leveraged positions.
rec: Your SOXL and SMH holdings are directly exposed. Consider trimming SOXL given its "SELL" status and significant loss, especially with margin amplifying drops.
